case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We thank you for your proposal and welcome the idea of a 24-month contract to ensure stability for both our houses. However, the prices you suggest are unfortunately not feasible given the wage developments we face. 

For our core offer, we propose a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We are prepared to accept the 45-day payment term and the 24-month contract, but we must adjust the price to €51.40 per unit to maintain our high quality standards. As an alternative package beside our main proposal, we can offer a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and your continued partnership with our family foundry. 

For our main Angebot, we can provide a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days. 

Beside this option, in response to your movement, we have adjusted our price to €51.10 for the 45-day payment term and 24-month contract. To state this alternative clearly, it offers a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

We hope this brings us closer to an agreement that reflects the quality and reliability you expect from our foundry.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your revised proposal; we appreciate your continued movement and your commitment to our long-standing partnership.

For our current offer, we propose a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

As an alternative, in response, we are prepared to reduce our price to €50.90 for the 45-day payment term and 24-month contract, which reflects a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

We trust this further concession demonstrates our willingness to find a fair way forward for both our houses. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your revised proposal and your continued steps towards our position. Our foundry has stood for quality and trust in our region for generations, and we deeply value the long-standing partnership we have built with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over the years. 

In response, we are prepared to adjust our price to a price of €51.00 per unit for the 60-day payment term and 24-month contract. To state all details of our proposal clearly: we offer a price of €51.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

We trust this brings us closer to a final agreement that reflects our long-standing partnership. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
